other_conditions: The worker must be registered under the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB) with regular membership
The disability must be caused by an accident at the workplace during the course of employment
Application must be made within one year of becoming disabled
A disability certificate issued by the Government Medical Board is required
The applicant must add a minimum of 90 days of work experience from the preceding year after registration
A registration fee must be paid before availing benefits
benefits_summary: A lump‑sum assistance of ₹1.50 lakh to ₹3.00 lakh is provided based on the percentage of disability (up to 50%, 51‑75%, and 76%+).
documents_required: Disability Certificate issued by the Government Medical Board
